quarterly_data.signal: Customer J. MURPHY & SONS LIMITED: supply contract signed 10-01-2026 for the supply and installation of 400kV transmission-grid cable, supply region United Kingdom. Contract value KRW 187,172,249,990 -- GBP 104,088,672.00 converted at Hana Bank's first-posted GBP/KRW rate of 1,798.20 on the contract date -- 9.15% of revenue (KRW 2,044,552,052,338, FY2025 year-end consolidated). Start 10-01-2026; the end date is not yet fixed: the project runs from materials supply through installation and construction, and the overall schedule is to be notified by the counterparty through a separate project instruction (PMI) after the owner's notice to proceed (NTP), with a correction filing once the end date is fixed. No down payment or advance; billed and paid as supply progresses. Amount and term may change with actual supply progress.
